name: Ultimo Pay Platinum Card
summary: Offshore Visa debit card with global ATM access. Convert BTC/USDT to USD and spend worldwide. BTC collateral loans available up to 50% of holdings.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Ultimo Pay Platinum Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$450.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Ultimo Pay Platinum Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
